items.heading: Couscous with Lamb
details: Key ingredients: couscous, lamb, chickpeas, vegetables, harissa
Steam couscous grains over a simmering pot of lamb and vegetable stew.
Cook the lamb with chickpeas, carrots and turnips until tender.
Fluff the steamed couscous with a little oil and broth.
Serve the couscous topped with the stew and a side of harissa.

items.heading: Chakhchoukha
details: Key ingredients: rougag flatbread, lamb, tomato sauce, chickpeas, spices
Bake and tear thin rougag flatbread into small pieces.
Simmer lamb with tomatoes, chickpeas and warming spices into a rich sauce.
Soak the torn flatbread in some of the sauce until softened.
Top with the remaining lamb and sauce before serving.
